enum.name: normal
enum.help: One knob, grows left to right

enum.name: auto
enum.help: Decide based on width an height

prop.name: min_value
prop.help: Set minimum value. If `min_value` > `max_value` fills from the right

prop.name: max_value
prop.help: Set maximum value. If `min_value` > `max_value` fills from the right

prop.name: start_value
prop.help: Set start value in range mode

prop.name: orientation
prop.help: Set the orientation to horizontal, vertical or auto

part.name: main
part.help: The track/background: background properties. padding makes the indicator smaller in the respective direction.

part.name: indicator
part.help: The filled portion that shows the value: background properties.

part.name: knob
part.help: The draggable handle: background, border, shadow and padding properties. Use knob|pressed for drag feedback; range mode draws two knobs.
